purpose: Per-race tier labels for the URA Finale schedule, joined by race identity rather than by the export numeric grade code, per R72.

umaguide.page_date_note: none published: no Last-Modified header, no time element, no generated-at field in the chunk; only the fetch date is known

game8.covers: graded races only (G1/G2/G3); carries no Open and no Pre-OP row

rule: A row takes a label only where both publishers give the same single label for that race and at least one page date postdates 2026-07-01 (G1/G2/G3), or where the client name of the row itself carries the open glyph (three Open rows). Code 400 additionally keeps the existing code-level pin on the remaining rows, marked per_row_sourced false and scope code-level-client-naming-pin so the generalisation is visible per row. Pre-OP is labelled by one publisher only and so is null.
